ROW.COLUMN: Money launderers may establish a number of accounts within a single institution, often establishing relationships at multiple branches using aliases or slightly different identifying information. They then move their money between the accounts as part of a layering strategy, often consolidating the funds in a single account before removing them from the institution. Without a known link, institutions have an extremely difficult time identifying these relationships. This scenario detects an account that conducts journal transactions to one or more unrelated accounts. A journal transaction is considered unrelated when the transaction occurs between accounts that are not in the same household, are not known to have a formal relationship, and have no common customers. The aggregated value for all transactions must be higher than a specified threshold, and the transactions must be conducted within a specified look back period (e.g., 14 calendar days).

A journal transaction is considered unrelated when the transaction occurs between an account and an offset account that are not in the same household, do not have a family (FM) relationship, and have no common customers. In addition, both the account and offset account IDs in the transaction record must not be null.

-- jurisdictons thresholds and (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' or a.JRSDCN_CD in (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- both the account and offset account IDs on transaction record must not be null and b.ACCT_INTRL_ID is not null and b.OFFST_ACCT_INTRL_ID is not null -- Included Trans Source Codes and (@All_Trans_Src_Fl = 'Y' or b.SRC_SYS_CD in (@Incl_Trans_Src_Lst)) --exclude trusted transactions and (@Incl_Trusted_Trans_Fl= 'Y' or coalesce(b.trstd_trxn_fl, 'N') = 'N') and b.EXCTN_DT <= (select cl.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and b.EXCTN_DT > (select add_days(cl.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and b.DATA_DUMP_DT <= (select cl.CLNDR_DT from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0) and b.DATA_DUMP_DT > (select add_days(cl.CLNDR_DT, - @Look_Back_Period) from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cl where cl.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and cl.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0)
